## How this file is maintained

- The block between the `tracker:begin/end` markers is regenerated by `node scripts/tracker.mjs --write` after any change to `docs/FEATURE_TRACKER.md`. `--check` fails if it is stale, and Claude Code's Stop hook runs that check automatically.
- Whichever agent finishes a meaningful piece of work updates the sections above. Verified changes go to `CHANGELOG.md`, decisions to `DECISIONS.md`, and cross-agent requests to `HANDOFFS.md`.
